newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL TRADE SURPLUS TO AUG 10 $186 MLN-MINISTRY.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL TRADE SURPLUS TO AUG 10 $186 MLN-MINISTRY.

text.p: Brazil posted a $186 million trade surplus between August 1-10, with exports of $1.473 billion and imports of $1.287 billion, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said Monday.
The ministry said in a statement average daily exports so far in the month were $245.5 million and average daily imports were $214.5 million.
In the first week of the month, consisting of one working day, exports were $257 million while imports were $149 million.
In the second week of the month, exports reached $1.216 billion, or $243.2 million a day, and imports stood at $1.138 billion, or $227.6 million a day.
Brazil posted a $811 million trade deficit in July, bringing the shortfall for the year so far to $5.516 billion.
